evals.prompt: I'm launching my streetwear brand's fall drop and need a 15-second video of a model power-walking down a city street showing off the full outfit. Write me a prompt I can paste into Higgsfield.
evals.expected_output: A production-grade Seedance 2.0 video prompt (~15-25 lines) for a streetwear lookbook. It opens with a 2-second hook (e.g. model power-walk straight at camera or outfit reveal), then has distinct labeled sections for environment/lighting, camera movement, and a second-by-second timeline, all framed to showcase the outfit and fabric in motion.
expectations: Output references Seedance 2.0 (and/or Higgsfield) as the target video engine
Output contains an explicit 2-second opening hook describing what appears in the first 0-2 seconds
Output has clearly labeled camera, lighting/environment, and second-by-second timeline sections
Output centers a model and the outfit/garment, emphasizing movement or fabric motion rather than abstract product shots

evals.prompt: Make my new dress collection look like a movie scene with dramatic lighting and a confident model on a runway. I want a video prompt for it.
evals.expected_output: A production-grade Seedance 2.0 fashion/runway prompt (~15-25 lines) that interprets the cinematic, dramatic-lighting request as a fashion lookbook rather than a generic film scene. It leads with a 2-second hook (e.g. dramatic reveal or runway descent), specifies dramatic lighting, camera moves, and a timeline, while keeping the model and dress collection as the subject.
expectations: Output is structured as a fashion/runway showcase centered on the model and the dress collection, not a generic narrative film scene
Output specifies dramatic/editorial lighting as requested
Output includes a 2-second hook plus labeled camera and timeline sections
Output references Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield as the generation engine

evals.prompt: Can you write me an OOTD reel prompt? Just my outfit of the day, head-to-toe, with a clean studio vibe and a slow spin so people can see all the angles.
evals.expected_output: A production-grade Seedance 2.0 prompt (~15-25 lines) for an OOTD outfit showcase. It opens with a 2-second hook (e.g. accessory close-up to full look or rotation reveal), specifies a clean studio environment and lighting, a rotating/spin camera move to show all angles, and a second-by-second timeline.
expectations: Output is framed as an OOTD / outfit showcase focused on a single head-to-toe look
Output includes a 360-degree or partial rotation/spin camera movement to reveal all angles
Output specifies a clean studio environment and lighting setup
Output contains a 2-second hook and a second-by-second timeline section for a roughly 15-second clip
